$comment: Testplan TC-command anti-pattern list (RETRO-2026-07 One change; proposed in RETRO-2026-05 and left unowned for three months). Consumed by validate-frontmatter.js as warn-tier rule W5 — non-fatal (ADR-0061), same stance as W1/W2/W3/W4, so it never fails pm:lint and never blocks a phase merge. Scope: fenced ```bash blocks inside 33-Testplans/**/TESTPLAN-*.md only. Each entry carries `id`, `pattern` (JS RegExp source), optional `flags`, `reason` (one clause, cited in the warning) and `fix`. Data-driven by design: extend this list WITHOUT touching validator code. ESCAPING: this is JSON, so a regex backslash needs TWO here (`\s`, `\b`, `\|`) and a LITERAL backslash needs FOUR (`\\`). A first draft used four everywhere and silently turned `\|` into 'any literal backslash OR ...', producing 439 false positives against unrelated greps. PRECISION IS THE POINT — re-measure the whole corpus before adding or editing an entry.

patterns.reason: a drive-lettered absolute path only resolves on one machine, so the TC cannot run unattended anywhere else
patterns.fix: use a repo-relative path, or resolve at run time (`process.cwd()`, `os.tmpdir()`, `__dirname`)

patterns.reason: `/tmp` does not exist on Windows, so the TC is not cross-platform (precedent: BUG-20260607-02)
patterns.fix: use `os.tmpdir()` in Node, or the project scratchpad — never a hardcoded POSIX temp path

patterns.reason: `~` is shell-expanded and does not resolve inside a Node string or on every shell
a recursive force-delete aimed at a literal path can destroy real work if the path resolves unexpectedly
patterns.fix: scope the removal to a temp dir held in a variable (`OUT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/x" && rm -rf "$OUT"`), or assert rather than delete
patterns.$note: Deliberately does NOT fire when the target is a variable (`"$OUT"`, `"${TMPDIR}/x"`) — that is the correct scoped idiom, used 15 times in TESTPLAN-22.1.01 alone. Flagging it would be noise, and a noisy warn-tier rule gets ignored, which is how the defect class survived three months in the first place.

patterns.reason: a force-push, hard reset or force-clean inside a TC can discard committed or uncommitted work
patterns.fix: assert on git state instead of mutating it; if a TC must mutate, do it in a temp clone

patterns.reason: piping a gate into tail/head replaces the real exit status with tail's, so the gate can never fail (BUG-20260608-01)
patterns.fix: gate on the exit code — `npm run pm:lint >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo OK`
